name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: A healthy and well-fed deshi cow, raised on natural grass and hay. Strong build with a calm temperament, ideal for Qurbani. Verified by local veterinarian.

name: Brahman Bull
description: A premium Brahman bull with impressive size and healthy weight. Known for disease resistance and excellent meat quality. Fully vaccinated and ready for Qurbani.

name: Sindhi Red Bull
description: The Sindhi Red is renowned for its striking appearance and lean, flavorful meat. This specimen has been raised on a balanced diet and is in peak physical condition.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: The Black Bengal is one of Bangladesh's most prized goat breeds, famous for its tender meat and compact size. This young male is healthy, active, and Qurbani-ready.

name: Jamnapari Goat
description: A large and majestic Jamnapari goat with long drooping ears. Imported breed with excellent body weight. Ideal for those seeking a premium Qurbani goat.

name: Frisian Cross Cow
description: A Frisian crossbreed raised at an agricultural farm. Exceptionally large frame with premium quality meat. One of the finest animals available this Qurbani season.

name: Sirohi Goat
description: The Sirohi is a hardy goat breed well-adapted to Bangladesh's climate. Good muscle development and a calm nature make it a top Qurbani choice.

name: Sahiwal Cow
description: The Sahiwal is a tropical breed known for heat tolerance and meat quality. This cow has been raised with premium feed in Pabna. A reliable Qurbani animal.
